title: Mobile sprint planning with owners and deadlines
description: Sprint planning with six clearly-assigned tasks carrying owners, deadlines, and acceptance criteria, plus two non-actionable status notes (hiring update, vacation). Tests owner/deadline capture and resistance to turning FYIs into tasks.

expected_tasks.name: Fix Android 14 photo upload crash
key_points: NullPointerException in the media picker callback when app is backgrounded mid-upload
repro: start photo upload, background the app, return
QA (Sam) verifies on Android 14 test devices

expected_tasks.name: Build notes sync API for offline mode
key_points: client sends last-synced timestamp, receives delta of created/updated/deleted notes
conflict resolution is last-write-wins; no merge UI this pass

expected_tasks.name: Implement offline mode on the mobile client
key_points: local cache in Room, queue writes offline, replay on reconnect
acceptance: open app in airplane mode, view and edit notes, reconcile online with no data loss

expected_tasks.name: Migrate CI from Jenkins to GitHub Actions
key_points: finish test and release pipelines (build job PoC exists)
run both systems in parallel for a week; keep Jenkins alive until the parallel week is clean

expected_tasks.name: Add per-user rate limiting to the search endpoint
Rebuild GDPR consent screen
key_points: opt-in consent with separate toggles for analytics and marketing

expected_tasks.name: Write regression tests for the payments flow
key_points: cover purchase, restore, cancellation, receipt validation
run in CI as part of the new GitHub Actions pipeline

must_not_extract.reason: explicitly stated as a status note with nothing for the team to do
